confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Dambulla's tourist pricing (Cultural Triangle guesthouses, restaurants and bars near Sigiriya); no live listings or menus were checked. Accommodation and drinks are the least certain. Cocktail and wine anchors are set as premiums over the beer anchor because direct local knowledge is weak. Sri Lankan rupee prices move with currency volatility, so treat all anchors as indicative. FX: the RBA exchange-rates overview URL is the intended provenance, but the 0.6955 value on 2026-10-15 came from a search-result summary; I did not open the RBA page, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the Sri Lankan Cultural Triangle tourist market (Sigiriya, Habarana, Kandy) and general South Asian tourist-town pricing. Dambulla is a small, guesthouse-heavy town with prices somewhat below Kandy's city-centre hotels.
